title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 6 Doyers Street in New York, New York, as the "Mabel Lee Memorial Post Office".
official_summary: (Sec. 1) Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 6 Doyers Street in New York, New York, as the "Mabel Lee Memorial Post Office."

summary.headline: A law that renames a New York City post office at 6 Doyers Street in honor of Mabel Lee.
summary.what_it_does: This law officially names the Postal Service facility at 6 Doyers Street in New York, New York, the "Mabel Lee Memorial Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, mail rules, or how the office is run.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 24, 2018.
